title: Photo Duo 146 · 애슬리트 USSBBW × 콜로설 · 둘 다 걸터앉기
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A photograph of TWO women seated side by side on one short backless bench carved from a solid block of pale grey stone, just long enough for the two of them and no longer, in a bare gallery space with a plain smooth deep-charcoal wall behind them, the camera set close at bench level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, seated with their knees apart and their feet flat on the floor, their two bodies together overflowing the stone on both sides and filling the frame from edge to edge, their hips and sides pressed against each other and the flesh bulging out where they touch.

Left woman: a Latina woman in her late 40s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, waist-length locs with gold cuffs. The body of a world's strongest woman pushed far past real limits: enormously broad thick shoulders, massive heavy arms so thick they cannot lie flat against her sides, a colossal bust, a huge barrel torso, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Colossal wide hips and a huge rounded powerful rear, tree-trunk thighs. The muscle is huge but rounded and buried under a thick layer of soft fat, broad blunt swells with no sharp separation. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Oaxacan alebrije — her own skin tone as the base, densely painted with neon magenta, yellow, lime green, turquoise and orange dots, stripes and zigzags, a bright striped band following every curve, no animal figures.

Right woman: an East African woman in her late 20s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, long finger waves past her shoulders. A giantess built on a completely even scale, every part enlarged by the same amount: massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full bust, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, enormous columnar thighs. Her shoulders span more than four head-widths and each hand is as wide as a normal woman's torso. No single part stands out more than another, no hanging folds, not pregnant. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in stained glass — glowing panes of ruby, sapphire, emerald, amber and violet fitted together by thick black lead lines, rose-window medallions on the bust and torso, the lead lines following every deep crease.

Their outer hands rest on the stone beside their hips, their inner hands on their own thighs. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation photograph, taller than it is wide.
